units.policy_raw: unbounded Gaussian latent; here conditional deterministic mean with rho=.9

source_frozen_reference.P02_authored_changes: FR knee only; original phase-entry wheel vector is zero after authored P01 stop. Current continuous scheduler keeps source-owner clocks, not zeroing other channels from P02 changed_channels.
source_frozen_reference.P03_RL_difference: Existing frozen fsm_states normal_correction_fractions[10]=-.149 in logical_command: .61*(1-.149)=.51911. This is shared source tuning, not current PPO residual or a similarity acceptance gate.
source_frozen_reference.same_nominal_values_are_not_an_independe: N is the shared source suggestion in the PPO trajectory. Later physical-feedback timing can differ from a separate B run; no current A/B paired result is inferred.

mask_and_dispatch.scope_limitation: No fixed masked-zero or missing-wheel dispatch is observed in this run/window; this does not audit every prior run/reset/global configuration.

whole_window.layer: nonzero policy residual -> verified dispatched target; shared N wheels are zero

P02.layer: nonzero residual while source N wheels still zero, not dropped nominal

P02_forward.layer: policy residual changes all four nonzero N targets; RR reduced most, no other-wheel cancellation

source_stop_or_differential.layer: source/N owner changes to P03, before PPO addition; zeros in FR/RR nominal are authored stop, not residual permission mask

first_observed_difference.timing_scope: First saved decision endpoint for policy-layer comparisons, not the first changed 120Hz actuator sample. Source/N change points are exact 120Hz poststep-associated dispatch ticks.

same_step_evidence.clock_semantics: poststep episode tick; preceding dispatch has reset/settle native clock offset +179, not same numeric time axis

findings: All four P02 wheel final targets and measured angular velocities are present. At all 194 forward endpoints every wheel has |target|>0.01 and |measured canonical qd|>0.01 rad/s; RR-only rotation/dispatch is not supported.
Policy slows RR (mean delta -.126913 rad/s), while FL/FR/RL retain forward targets. It does not cancel the other three wheels here.

Measured tracking differs: FL RMS error .128860 rad/s; FR AIR rotates close to target but contributes no ground contact force at selected forward shots. RL/RR can exceed target due to coupled dynamics; telemetry alone does not establish a unique load/motor-fault cause or traction fraction.
Wheel-centre translation is separately retained and is not wheel spin. This newer run cannot conclusively explain which feature made RR look dominant in an earlier user's video.
No confirmed wiring/mask implementation bug established here; no production/reward/HISTORY/temperature change or new simulation performed.

prior_P06_diagnostic_reused.classification: stochastic training block02 with optimizer updates, not fixed-CP current B pair
prior_P06_diagnostic_reused.finding: Previously recorded P06 also had all four N/baselines +.300 and all four measured rotations; FL could reverse at eight sampled targets due to policy residual, RR was slowed. This supports separating policy cancellation from masking, not declaring every task solved.
